summary: The Edison Electric Institute is mentioned solely as a co-sponsor of a major study of time-of-day metering and load management systems, undertaken at the request of NARUC. The document references this study in the context of evaluating conservation and rate revision as alternatives to the proposed Bad Creek Project. No position for or against the project is attributed to the Edison Electric Institute.
complaint_summary: The Edison Electric Institute, together with the Electric Power Research Institute, is noted as conducting a major study of time-of-day metering and load management systems at NARUC's request, cited as evidence that such alternatives are still under study and not yet proven as substitutes for new generating capacity.
summary_quote: A major study of time-of-day metering and load management systems by the Edison Electric Institute and the Electric Power Research Institute has been undertaken at the request of the National Association of Regulatory Commissioners (NARUC).
